text:
A ball is dropped onto a floor.
Its speed just before hitting the floor is 3.0m/s.
Which change would result in a speed of 6.0m/s just before hitting the floor?
Ignore any effects due to air resistance.
A
Drop the ball from double the height above the floor.
B
Drop the ball from four times the height above the floor.
C
Use a ball with double the mass.
D
Use a ball with four times the mass.

options.label: A
options.text: Drop the ball from double the height above the floor.

options.label: B
options.text: Drop the ball from four times the height above the floor.

options.label: C
options.text: Use a ball with double the mass.

options.label: D
options.text: Use a ball with four times the mass.
